config.toleranceRationale: 0.27 deg is the Sun's angular radius: inside this band the solar disc is partly cut by terrain, and it is also the scale of error expected from 1-degree azimuth bins and 40-120 m DEM cells. Samples inside the band are classified 'uncertain', not visible or obstructed. The same band is applied to Earth.
config.nearFieldRationale: Terrain closer than 120 m (three 40 m DEM cells) is treated as the landing spot itself, not as horizon. At grazing Sun angles, metre-scale relief inside this distance dominates the horizon on ridge crests, yet the DEM does not resolve it reliably and lander placement controls it. 120 m gave the best agreement with the published LOLA illumination maps (see benchmark).

requirements.label: Sun-visible share
requirements.rationale: Enough sunlit time for solar-powered surface operations.

requirements.label: Longest Sun obstruction
requirements.rationale: Darkness the lander must survive on battery and heaters.

requirements.label: Earth-visible share
requirements.rationale: Geometric DTE availability (not a link budget).

requirements.label: Longest gap without Earth
requirements.rationale: Onboard autonomy and data buffering duration.

requirements.label: Battery margin above floor (est.)
requirements.rationale: Minimum charge stays at least 10% of capacity above the 20% depth-of-discharge floor (i.e. never below 30% charge). The change-spec '20% battery' is the floor itself, so it is expressed here as a margin above it; 0 means the battery reached the floor.

adapter.frameNote: DE440 lunar mean-Earth/polar-axis frame; planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
adapter.observer: MOON (centre); site parallax applied by the caller
adapter.timeSystem: UTC input, converted to TDB with naif0012.tls (TDB = UTC + 69.184 s in 2017-2030+)
adapter.aberrationNote: LT+S: apparent position (one-way light time and stellar aberration), the direction in which the body is actually seen

terrain.method: radial max elevation angle with curvature correction (exact 3-D, sphere R=1737.4 km), finest DEM per sample, 5 sub-rays per 1 deg bin (max), terrain closer than 120 m excluded (treated as the site)

sunlitPct.label: Sun visible
sunlitPct.method: Share of samples classified visible: Sun centre elevation above the terrain horizon at its azimuth by more than the tolerance.

earthVisiblePct.label: Earth visible
earthVisiblePct.method: Share of samples classified visible: Earth centre above max(terrain horizon, minimum antenna elevation) by more than the tolerance.

sunVisibleH.label: Total Sun-visible duration
sunVisibleH.method: Number of visible samples times the sampling step.

earthVisibleH.label: Total Earth-visible duration
earthVisibleH.method: Number of visible samples times the sampling step.

longestDarkGapH.label: Longest Sun obstruction
longestDarkGapH.method: Longest run of consecutive samples in which the Sun is not classified visible, times the step.

longestNoEarthGapH.label: Longest Earth obstruction
longestNoEarthGapH.method: Longest run of consecutive samples in which Earth is not classified visible, times the step.

timeToSunsetH.label: First sunset
timeToSunsetH.method: From T+0, the first visible-to-not-visible Sun transition. Empty when none falls inside the mission.

timeToSunriseH.label: First sunrise
timeToSunriseH.method: From T+0, the first not-visible-to-visible Sun transition.

meanSunElDeg.label: Mean Sun elevation while visible
meanSunElDeg.method: Mean Sun centre elevation over visible samples.

maxSunElDeg.label: Maximum Sun elevation
maxSunElDeg.method: Highest Sun centre elevation in the mission, regardless of terrain.

maxEarthElDeg.label: Maximum Earth elevation
maxEarthElDeg.method: Highest Earth centre elevation in the mission, regardless of terrain.

shadowLengthM.label: Shadow of a 1 m rock
shadowLengthM.method: 1 m / tan(mean Sun elevation while visible), on flat ground.

energyWh.label: Generated energy (estimate)
energyWh.method: Sum of P(t) x step, P = A x eta x 1361 W/m2 x (1 AU/r)^2 x cos(theta) x sunVisible x (1 - losses), selected panel type.

verticalToHorizontalRatio.label: Vertical vs horizontal array energy
verticalToHorizontalRatio.method: Energy of a vertical Sun-tracking array (cos theta = cos el) divided by a horizontal one (cos theta = sin el), same area and efficiency.

minSocPct.label: Minimum battery charge (estimate)
minSocPct.method: Battery simulation: constant load, starts at the initial charge, charge clamped to capacity, discharge stops at the depth-of-discharge floor.

socMarginPct.label: Battery margin above floor (estimate)
socMarginPct.method: Minimum charge minus the depth-of-discharge floor (100% - DoD). Zero means the battery reached the floor.

brownoutMetH.label: Battery reaches floor (estimate)
brownoutMetH.method: First mission time at which the charge reaches capacity x (1 - DoD).

requiredStorageWh.label: Storage for the longest Sun obstruction (estimate)
requiredStorageWh.method: load x longest Sun obstruction / usable depth of discharge (rule of thumb).

energyBalanceWh.label: Energy balance (estimate)
energyBalanceWh.method: Generated energy minus load energy over the mission.
